title: AffineModuleTensorCoherenceComparisons
statement: Let $f:U\to X$ be affine, $A=f_*O_U$, $R$ pushforward as an $A$-module, $S$ scalar restriction to $O_X$. Given a pushout $B$ of $r_0:f^{-1}O_X\to O_U$ and $t_0:f^{-1}O_X\to f^{-1}A$, maps $b,t,\epsilon$ with $b\epsilon=1$, $t\epsilon=e$ (the ring counit), functors $P,H$ with their tensor objects and map formulas, an isomorphism $\kappa:P\operatorname{Res}_b\simeq Sf^*$ with the pullback-unit tensor formula, and $\gamma:Sf^*\to H$ with the scalar-extension unit formula, $H$ preserves quasi-coherence. There are natural $\alpha:RH\to1$ and $\beta:1\to HR$ such that $\gamma_{RF}\alpha_F$ is the pullback counit and $S\beta_G$ is the canonical pullback adjoint of $\gamma_G$. Conventions: [def-pc-scheme], [pqf-def-affine-morphism], [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], [pqf-def-coherent], [def-pc-module-pullback], [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product], [lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction].

proof.text: Prove preservation of quasi-coherence: the pushout algebra B is quasi-coherent, A is quasi-coherent by affine relative Spec, scalar restriction and pullback give quasi-coherence of P(G) after restriction via kappa, and algebra change of rings along epsilon gives quasi-coherence of H(G). The source-library unit instance handles the identity algebra.

Obtain objectwise counit factors and epimorphy of gamma_RF. A proved generic categorical helper constructs alpha from these factors. Precompose its desired naturality equation with gamma_RF; gamma naturality, the factor equations and counit naturality prove it. Cancel the epimorphism. Hence the factor is unique, so this chooses no undetermined data. The generic helper takes the pullback adjunction with right adjoint R followed by S, definitionally the scheme-module pushforward.

A proved generic categorical helper assembles the objectwise algebra-linear lifts of the adjoints of gamma_G. The Hom-equivalence naturality and gamma naturality make these adjoints natural after scalar restriction. Restriction of scalars is injective on morphisms, since it retains section functions, as proved by sectionwise extensionality in a private helper. Thus the lifts are unique and natural. Form beta and combine its equation with alpha and quasi-coherence.

proof_origin.note: Compiled reduction along the original Stacks 01SB route: quasi-coherence plus objectwise factors, with both naturality proofs in Lean.

theorem affine_module_tensor_coherenceComparisons [IsAffineHom f]
    (B : U.toTopCat.Sheaf CommRingCat.{u}) (b : U.sheaf ⟶ B) (t : IA ⟶ B)
    (ε : B ⟶ U.sheaf) (hpush : IsPushout r₀ t₀ b t)
    (hb : b ≫ ε = 𝟙 U.sheaf) (ht : t ≫ ε = e₀)
    (P : SheafOfModules.{u} (𝓡 A) ⥤ SheafOfModules.{u} (𝓡 B))
        (pobj : ∀ G, P.obj G = SheafOfModules.changeOfRings.{u, u, u} t (I G))
        (κ : P ⋙ SheafOfModules.restrictScalars (𝓻 b) ≅ S ⋙ tensorPullback f)
    (H : SheafOfModules.{u} (𝓡 A) ⥤ U.Modules)
          (hobj : ∀ G, H.obj G = SheafOfModules.changeOfRings.{u, u, u} ε (P.obj G))
          (γ : S ⋙ tensorPullback f ⟶ H)
    (hP :
        (∀ (G G' : SheafOfModules.{u} (𝓡 A)) (a : G ⟶ G'),
          P.map a = eqToHom (pobj G) ≫
            SheafOfModules.changeOfRingsHom.{u, u, u} t (I G)
              (TopCat.Sheaf.inverseImageModuleMap f.base A G a) ≫
            eqToHom (pobj G').symm) ∧
        (∀ (G : SheafOfModules.{u} (𝓡 A)) (V : (Opens X)ᵒᵖ) (g : G.val.obj V),
          ((eqToHom (pobj G)).val.app ((Opens.map f.base).op.obj V))
            ((κ.inv.app G).val.app ((Opens.map f.base).op.obj V)
              (((adj₀).unit.app ((S).obj G)).val.app V g)) =
            ((PresheafOfModules.sheafificationAdjunction (𝟙 (𝓡 B).obj)).unit.app
              (SheafOfModules.changeOfRingsPresheaf.{u, u, u} t (I G))).app
                ((Opens.map f.base).op.obj V)
                ((1 : B.obj.obj ((Opens.map f.base).op.obj V))
                  ⊗ₜ[(IA).obj.obj ((Opens.map f.base).op.obj V),(t.hom.app
                    ((Opens.map f.base).op.obj V)).hom]
                  (((Functor.sheafPullbackConstruction.sheafAdjunctionContinuous
                    (Opens.map f.base) AddCommGrpCat.{u} (𝓙 X) (𝓙 U)).unit.app
                      ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf (𝓡 A)).obj G)).hom.app V g))))
    (hH :
          (∀ (G G' : SheafOfModules.{u} (𝓡 A)) (a : G ⟶ G'),
            H.map a = eqToHom (hobj G) ≫
              SheafOfModules.changeOfRingsHom.{u, u, u} ε (P.obj G) (P.map a) ≫
              eqToHom (hobj G').symm) ∧
          (∀ (G : SheafOfModules.{u} (𝓡 A)) (W : (Opens U)ᵒᵖ)
              (p : (P.obj G).val.obj W),
            ((eqToHom (hobj G)).val.app W)
              ((γ.app G).val.app W ((κ.hom.app G).val.app W p)) =
              ((PresheafOfModules.sheafificationAdjunction (𝟙 U.ringCatSheaf.obj)).unit.app
                (SheafOfModules.changeOfRingsPresheaf.{u, u, u} ε (P.obj G))).app W
                  ((1 : U.sheaf.obj.obj W) ⊗ₜ[B.obj.obj W,(ε.hom.app W).hom] p))) :
          (∀ G : SheafOfModules.{u} (𝓡 A),
            G.IsQuasicoherent → (H.obj G).IsQuasicoherent) ∧
          ∃ (α : R ⋙ H ⟶ 𝟭 U.Modules) (β : 𝟭 (SheafOfModules.{u} (𝓡 A)) ⟶ H ⋙ R),
            (∀ F : U.Modules, γ.app ((R).obj F) ≫ α.app F = (adj₀).counit.app F) ∧
            (∀ G : SheafOfModules.{u} (𝓡 A),
              (S).map (β.app G) = ((adj₀).homEquiv ((S).obj G) (H.obj G)) (γ.app G))
